name: @aura3d/showcase-teleoperator
description: Aura3D 4.0.2 1:1 3D port of Teleoperator (teleoperator.mindblown.ai) — remote-pilot Waymo Jaguar I-PACE, Tesla Cybercab, Cybertruck FSD, Corvette ZR1X, and SpaceX Roadster across San Francisco with L5 self-driving, kerb pickup/dropoff beacons, and multiplayer peer nameplates.
